mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns despite FEDFUNDS declining for 3 months in the same period, or the decline reverses before 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A surprise quarterly GDP growth exceeding 3% in Q1 2008 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds previous quarter's value by >3% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or GDP growth does not exceed 3%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5% and 4.5% respectively in a month triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 5000 and UNRATE > 4.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite both proxies rising above thresholds, or the rise in UNRATE is not concurrent with PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% for 2 months predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive despite FEDFUNDS below 2% for 2 months, or the decline reverses before 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% above the previous month's level predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or the surge in HOUST does not precede returns.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in production index (INDPRO) exceeding 5% above its 12-month average predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > previous 12-month avg * 1.05 in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or the surge in INDPRO does not precede returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movements in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month averages trigger positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous 12-month avg and RSAFS > previous 12-month avg in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite both proxies rising above their averages, or the rise in one does not precede the other.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime (UNRATE >4.5%), a sudden drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive despite UNRATE dropping below 4.0% in the labor tightening regime, or the drop is not concurrent with returns.
